summary.text: Frontend Developer and Information Technology graduate from Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology (HUTECH) with hands-on experience building responsive web and mobile applications using Next.js, React.js, and React Native.

bullets.text: Translate detailed Figma designs into responsive, semantic frontend code and reusable components.
Develop with Next.js App Router, Server Components, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui.
Collaborate in Agile/Scrum and communicate in English with project stakeholders.
Clarified requirements, designed user experiences, and shipped frontend features across web and mobile.
Wrote Playwright end-to-end tests to verify product quality.
Developed web interfaces, integrated APIs, and collaborated on feature development and testing.
Built a React/TypeScript portfolio with Spec-Driven Development and Claude Code; captured requirements in SPEC.md and developed 23 React components.
Used AI-powered development and testing workflows with Playwright MCP for automated validation.
Built a Playwright/TypeScript framework with Page Object Model: 21 test cases across 4 browser and device targets, with traces and screenshots for debugging.
